term: fixed current-or-past contingent roster C and counterfactual includes in A5
definition: For the selected possible W, C describes all and only the PARTICULAR contingent things existing or having existed there. The source note’s four bearers are illustrative; fixed roster identity differs from A3’s nonrigid first occurrence. Includes means that Y would obtain or exist were X actual. An empty individual roster can therefore be represented by a negative C, not absence of a situation. The source mixes present and having-ever-been wording without supplying a formal time/world/Fact interpretation.
note: Do not reduce EVER commitments to present ExistsAt, assume a complete future history, treat inclusion as set membership, or infer that every required C is admitted as a fact token. Typed fixed-conjunction results cover positive member commitments only, not C’s full negative all-and-only content. Preservation of the same C at a possible caused occurrence remains an explicit interpretation obligation.
